The strict authority-envelope preflight already rejected these shapes, but direct caller-owned requests could still acquire a structural correlation digest. lesson: Nonblank untrusted timestamp claims are not necessarily well-formed or chronologically possible. Reuse the exact strict authority-metadata instant parser and submillisecond ordering helper in the standalone digest admission boundary instead of independently approximating Date.parse checks.
guardrail: Extract and reuse unchanged claimed-instant calendar/offset and submillisecond chronology guards across strict envelope preflight and standalone request transcript. Reject malformed or unknown-offset instants, receipt not before decision, revisions not after decision, and non-increasing correction observation times before hashing. Cover twelve direct-call negative mutations and preserve valid transcript bytes. These checks never attest a clock, settlement finality, source authenticity or scoring/production authority.
